title: Leveling reward cache consistency
items: Kept the persistent Leveling tab reward list synchronized immediately after reward mappings are added, changed or removed, preventing stale rewards from reappearing when the tab rerenders.
Preserved the persistent hash-tab dashboard and its instant cached navigation instead of forcing a page reload after reward changes.
Treat the website backend's Leveling reward fallback response as an actual unavailable-API error so bot API failures no longer masquerade as an empty reward configuration.

title: Leveling API error visibility
items: Stopped failed Leveling reward and role requests from being converted into successful-looking empty lists in the dashboard API client.
Preserved HTTP status, backend error details and diagnostics on failed dashboard JSON requests so Leveling failures can be surfaced and debugged instead of appearing as missing configuration.
Kept demo-mode Leveling data read-only and unchanged while retaining the existing authenticated Leveling validation and request cache behavior.
